intro: The Tome of Divinity is a sacred trial of faith and sacrifice for paladins in Elwynn Forest. After an ambush by Defias mages leaves the scout Henze Faulk dead at Heroes' Vigil, an aspiring holy warrior must wield the Symbol of Life to resurrect him and thwart the brotherhood's encroaching schemes.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Henze and I had made it to Heroes' Vigil, an island in the middle of Stone Cairn Lake in northeastern Elwynn. We'd heard the Defias had infiltrated our borders and we wanted proof to take to the king's advisors.
We caught sight of a couple of the scum going over some documents, and we attacked. Unfortunately, we were quickly overwhelmed by more of the mages.
Henze held them off for me while I escaped... The daft fool, going and being brave.
He's out there now, Henze is. Can you help us, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Seeing you wield the Symbol of Life, may I assume Duthorian or Gazin sent you?
I fell to the Defias spell casters while Gazin and I tried to get their plans from them: I was able to hold on long enough to allow Gazin to escape, but in the end, their magics overwhelmed me.
But you were able to bring me back: the ability to use the Symbol doesn't come to just anyone, friend. It bodes well for you that you were able to empower it with your own faith.
